first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The bald, muscular figure in the left foreground, with their back to the camera; their light-colored head, neck, and bare shoulders have broad red markings, and they wear brown leather protective gear.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The short-haired figure seated on Animal A's saddle in the right midground, wearing a light gray-blue top, dark belt, and trousers.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The large, stocky quadruped in the right midground, with a gray-brown, purplish body, thick curved horns, a long tail, golden armor plates on its head and back, and tack.

entities.name: Dark Red Tree Canopy
entities.identification: The dark red and pink clusters of leaves and dark branching limbs at the top of the image.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The spear extending diagonally toward the upper right beside Person A, with a silver point and hanging dark red cloth.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The long-handled axe on Person A's back toward image-right, with a broad silver-gray axe head and a long brown handle.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The exposed upper section of the slender bow beside Person A's head and shoulders, with alternating dark and light sections on the bow and a thin diagonal string.

entities.name: Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate
entities.identification: The dark green-gray doorframe and orange-brown pointed vertical components in the left background, mostly occluded by Person A.

entities.name: Gray Stone Wall
entities.identification: The gray and green-gray stone building facade from the center to the right background, with a dark recessed area in the center.

entities.name: Gnarled Vines on the Wall
entities.identification: The thick gray-brown roots, slender vines, and clusters of green leaves climbing over the background wall.

entities.name: Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground
entities.identification: The irregular blue-gray-green stone slabs and gravel in the lower part of the image, and the curved red-brown strips in the midground.

entities.name: Ground Moss
entities.identification: The green clumps of grass, low moss-like covering, and small number of broad-leaved plants in the stone joints and on the midground surface.

entities.name: Courtyard Fungal Clusters
entities.identification: Clusters of red-orange umbrella-shaped or funnel-shaped fungi on the ground, interspersed with smaller yellow-green caps.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: The long, curved silver-gray blade positioned diagonally across Person A's back, with a dark brown grip at its upper end.

A broad back strap with dark edging is visible, there are multiple horizontal straps and metallic buckles across the waist and back, and the muscular contours of the bare shoulders are prominent.
At frame 0, Person C has short hair and wears a light gray-blue top, a dark belt, and trousers; both hands are near the front of the body, and the lower body is partly occluded by the tack.

At frame 0, Person C has short hair close to the head and wears a light gray-blue top, a dark belt, and trousers; the neckline has a dark V-shaped overlapping trim, the cuffs and forearm areas are darker, and the belt has light-colored ring-shaped ornamentation. Both hands are near the front of the body, and the lower body is partly occluded by the tack and armor plates.

At frame 0, Animal A is a large, stocky quadruped with a gray-brown, purplish body, thick curved horns on both sides of its head, golden armor plates covering its head and back, and tack; its torso is angled toward the camera, and its flank and long tail are visible.

At frame 0, Animal A is a large, stocky quadruped with a gray-brown, purplish body, dark stripes, and darker lower legs; its feline-like face has a light-colored muzzle, blue eyes, and exposed fangs. The thick horns on both sides curve outward with upturned tips, and golden armor plates cover its head and back, with tack attached; the face armor has multiple ridges, the back armor has a continuous row of pointed plates, golden curved decorative plates and dark straps are visible at the side of the saddle, and a dark loop-shaped strap hangs below the muzzle. Its torso is angled toward the camera, and its flank and long tail are clearly visible.
At frame 0, the Dark Red Tree Canopy consists of large clusters of dark red and pink leaves and dark branching limbs.

At frame 0, the Dark Red Tree Canopy consists of layered clusters of dark red and pink leaves and dark branching limbs; the edges of the leaf clusters are irregular, there are light-colored highlights in places, and deep dark gaps are exposed between the branches and leaves.

At frame 0, Weapon A is a slender spear with a narrow, elongated silver point at the front; its shaft runs diagonally toward the upper right of the image, and a long piece of dark red cloth is tied to the shaft.

At frame 0, Weapon A is a slender spear whose silver point is shaped like a narrow, elongated leaf and has a bright edge, with the shaft running diagonally toward the upper right of the image; a long dark red cloth is tied at one point on the shaft and hangs downward, with longitudinal folds, and its lower part extends to the bottom edge of the image.
At frame 0, Weapon B is a long-handled axe with a broad silver-gray axe head and a brown handle.

At frame 0, Weapon B is a long-handled axe whose broad silver-gray axe head has a curved cutting edge, mottled bright markings, and a dark opening near the handle; the brown handle extends downward, and there are gold-colored and metallic decorations near the head-handle connection.

At frame 0, Weapon C is a partially visible slender bow; the exposed upper bow section alternates between dark and light, with a thin string beside it, while the lower section is occluded by Person A.
